segments.text: Engilis tiriini umunman bilmasayzam, noldan 30 gun uchidi gaparishini baxshisiz.
Man, techi razam 13 yilik tajribigi egi engilis tiri oqtotisman.
Va 22, 23, 24 sentyabr kunlari Beeple online masterclass-ta ishkiliyash siri yapman.
U shuk masterclass-ta qanay qalib noldan 30 gun uchidi engilis tiri kundalik mazuradi gaparishini baxshish.
Kundigi eliktigi chamsozini 10 son yotlap, realxayotlashatish.
Va ba 2 darijidigi sirsikat alishning samarali yollarini orgetaman.
Masterclassda katnash mutlaka beipul, fakat khawalan ustuki basip, yapik sirgam kanalamgi, koshir bolin.
